estimator.method: four-parameter GLS fit to bin-integrated phi harmonics
estimator.normalization: fitted p_n divided by full-phi hadron-weighted mean epsilon_n
estimator.raw_cell_layout: 16 phi counts followed by sum epsilon_n; covariance upper triangle
estimator.sin_phi: fit nuisance only; no polarized A_LU result from 00 samples

excluded_observable: A_LU^sin(phi_h) is not evaluated in the 00 samples because it requires the polarized muon beam

selection.hadron: stable unidentified charged hadron; pion-mass z convention

systematics: point-to-point systematic uncertainty is twice the tabulated statistical uncertainty, as stated for both integrated and 3D results
